products.description:
The Jordan 4 Retro London gives the AJ4 a look shaped by the city in its name. Dark Smoke Grey suede and textured overlays create a worn, concrete inspired appearance, with Hemp and Red Bark bringing earthy contrast. The darker palette keeps the shoe restrained from a distance, but its materials and small details make it rewarding to examine up close.

London references appear throughout the release. Nike LDN branding marks the heel tab and hangtag, while an upside down "SAY LESS" tag sits beneath the tongue. Red Bark laces are also included, giving collectors another way to wear the pair while keeping its original accessories together. The release was presented as a UK and European exclusive, making its regional identity central to the design rather than simply a nickname.

For AJ4 collectors, this pair offers a specific city story through color, texture, and branding. Those details give it a distinct place beside more widely released Jordan 4s. The Jordan 4 Retro London released September 12, 2026, with a retail price of $230.
products.title: Jordan 4 Retro London

products.description:
The Air Jordan 9 Retro OG Space Jam 2026 revives one of the most beloved and culturally significant colorways in Jordan Brand history, combining white, true red, and black to honor the original silhouette's connection to the beloved Space Jam film. Michael Jordan's Space Jam appearance remains one of the most iconic crossovers between basketball and Hollywood entertainment, giving this colorway genuine cinematic and cultural significance beyond a standard sneaker release. The OG designation reflects a faithful return to the exact color story and construction associated with this legendary release.

Space Jam holds a special place within both basketball and film history, representing a genuinely unique crossover moment that introduced Michael Jordan's legacy to audiences well beyond traditional basketball fandom. This white, true red, and black combination has become deeply embedded within Jordan Brand's storytelling, consistently ranking among the most celebrated and nostalgic color stories the Jordan 9 has ever produced. Collectors who appreciate both basketball history and this iconic film crossover find this Space Jam release a genuinely significant way to own a piece of this legendary cultural moment.

The Air Jordan 9 Retro OG Space Jam 2026 was released on September 19, 2026 with a retail price of $215.
products.title: Jordan 9 Retro OG Space Jam (2026)

products.description:
The Jordan 4 Retro J Balvin Lemonade covers the AJ4 in shades of yellow that make the collaboration recognizable at a glance. Croc textured leather adds depth across the upper, so the color does more than carry the design on its own. J Balvin’s upside down smiley face appears on one heel, while Nike Air branding marks the other, continuing the uneven branding details found in his Jordan releases.

Smaller touches connect the pair to Balvin’s Colombian roots. The lace dubraes carry "JUST DO IT." and "SOLO HAZLO.", and the color story draws on the vivid scenery associated with Medellín and Colombia’s Caño Cristales river. For collectors who have followed his previous Air Jordans, this marks his move to the Jordan 4 after collaborations on earlier models. Its bright treatment gives the partnership a new look while preserving the AJ4’s familiar structure.

It is a bold pair for Balvin fans and AJ4 collectors who enjoy color and close up details. The Jordan 4 Retro J Balvin Lemonade releases September 25, 2026, with a retail price of $225.
products.title: Jordan 4 Retro J Balvin Lemonade

products.description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow brings a vibrant, high visibility colorway into the beloved Jordan 4 silhouette, combining white, tour yellow, dark blue grey, and black into a genuinely striking presentation. The Rare Air naming ties this release to Michael Jordan's legendary competitive excellence, a phrase often associated with his singular, unmatched basketball talent. Tour yellow gives this pair significant standout presence, distinguishing it clearly from more common Jordan 4 color releases through its bold, energetic accent.

Rare Air as a concept has carried special significance within Jordan Brand's storytelling, celebrating Michael Jordan's singular basketball genius and the rarefied air of excellence he operated within throughout his career. This tour yellow execution gives the Jordan 4 genuine visual boldness, appealing to collectors who want their retro pairs to command serious attention. Fans of both Jordan Brand's storied competitive legacy and vibrant, high visibility colorways find this Rare Air release a compelling way to engage with the silhouette's continued evolution.

The Air Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow was released on September 5, 2026 with a retail price of $220.
products.title: Jordan 4 Retro Rare Air Tour Yellow (2026)

products.description:
The Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026) brings back one of the most recognizable non-OG colorways in the Jordan 4 archive, first introduced in 2013 during a wave of bold, lifestyle-driven releases. Dressed in fire red with white, black, and cement grey accents, the sneaker leans into high-impact color blocking that instantly stands out. The red nubuck upper gives the silhouette depth and texture, while black wings and midsole hits ground the design with contrast.

The "Toro Bravo" nickname draws from Spanish bullfighting culture, a theme Jordan Brand explored during the early 2010s when experimenting beyond traditional Bulls-inspired palettes. Unlike OG Jordan 4s tied directly to on-court moments, this pair became a streetwear favorite for its unapologetic use of color and premium materials. Over time, it’s been embraced as one of the most memorable modern-era Jordan 4s, bridging the gap between retro heritage and bold expression.

When the Air Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026) released, it retailed for $220. With its fire red, white, black, and cement grey colorway and its status as a fan-favorite return, this release reintroduces a defining Jordan 4 look that continues to resonate across sneaker culture.
products.title: Jordan 4 Retro Toro Bravo (2026)
